sources.snippet: Roman Urdu Sentiment Analysis Model (Khubaib01) This model performs sentiment classification on Roman Urdu text, labeling input sentences as Positive, Negative, or Neutral. It is fine-tuned from xlm-roberta-base and designed to handle Roman Urdu, code-mixed Urdu-English, and social media style text, including slang-heavy WhatsApp chats, YouTube comments, and Twitter posts.

sources.title: Roman Urdu Sentiment Analysis: Traditional Approaches vs LLMs
sources.snippet: Large language models (LLMs) have greatly contributed to the advancement of sentiment analysis across different languages. However, their ability to outperform traditional approaches remains largely unexplored, at least for the cases of Roman Urdu, a commonly used informal script for Urdu.
